title: Guidance And Counselling
modules: Records And Record Keeping In School
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered to be very important in the school guidance programme."
Records and record keeping is considered to be very important in the school guidance programme.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the factors that make counselling scientific and more objective."
Using psychological tests is one of the factors that make counselling scientific and more objective.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most widely known type of aptitude test."
The intelligence test is the most widely known type of aptitude test.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process of helping individuals or group of people to gain self-understanding in order to be themselves."
Counselling is a process of helping individuals or group of people to gain self-understanding in order to be themselves.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the relative low number of professionally trained counsellors to the entire population that needs the services."
Among these factors is the relative low number of professionally trained counsellors to the entire population that needs the services.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a skill of great sophistication, which is available to all counsellors."
Active listening is a skill of great sophistication, which is available to all counsellors.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with muscular and motor skills including the manipulation of materials requiring the eye and hand coordination with body movements."
Psychomotor is concerned with muscular and motor skills including the manipulation of materials requiring the eye and hand coordination with body movements.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of students with different personality make-up, traits and needs."
The students' body is made up of students with different personality make-up, traits and needs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as methods or ways of doing something or performing an act efficiently."
Technique can be defined as methods or ways of doing something or performing an act efficiently.
fib: ______ is the procedure and ways by which clients' problems are worked through.
Counselling process
Counselling process is the procedure and ways by which clients' problems are worked through.
______ is a continuum and any kind of division imposed on it is more or less arbitrary.
History
History is a continuum and any kind of division imposed on it is more or less arbitrary.
______ is the most important single record which provides for the recording of important data on the student.
cumulative record folder
The cumulative record folder is the most important single record which provides for the recording of important data on the student.
______ is the best word that summarises the functions of parents and guardians (Zeran & Riccio, 1962).
Cooperation
Cooperation is the best word that summarises the functions of parents and guardians (Zeran & Riccio, 1962).
______ is the same thing as preparatory or preparation stage.
initial phase
The initial phase is the same thing as preparatory or preparation stage.
______ is a body of trained guidance counselors mainly, but it encourages interested individuals in the helping professions to join it.
Association
The Association is a body of trained guidance counselors mainly, but it encourages interested individuals in the helping professions to join it.
______ is a very crucial aspect of the help giving service (Guidance and Counselling).
Vocational Guidance
Vocational Guidance is a very crucial aspect of the help giving service (Guidance and Counselling).
______ is the chief executive within the secondary school-system.
school-principal
The school-principal is the chief executive within the secondary school-system.
______ refers to the period when one is still day- dreaming about many careers that are attractive to an individual.
Fantasy stage
The Fantasy stage refers to the period when one is still day- dreaming about many careers that are attractive to an individual.
